# WhoGotSnow

> Live North American ski resort webcams ranked by modeled snowfall. See who's getting snow before you leave.

WhoGotSnow (https://whogotsnow.com/) is a free web app that aggregates public mountain webcam feeds and ranks mountains by Open-Meteo weather-model snowfall (not official resort snow reports).

## Site

- Homepage: https://whogotsnow.com/
- Mountain directory: https://whogotsnow.com/directory.html
- Region hubs: [Alaska](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/alaska.html), [Alberta](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/alberta.html), [Arizona](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/arizona.html), [British Columbia](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/british-columbia.html), [California](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/california.html), [Colorado](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/colorado.html), [Connecticut](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/connecticut.html), [Idaho](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/idaho.html), [Iowa](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/iowa.html), [Maine](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/maine.html), [Massachusetts](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/massachusetts.html), [Michigan](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/michigan.html), [Minnesota](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/minnesota.html), [Missouri](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/missouri.html), [Montana](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/montana.html), [Nevada](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/nevada.html), [New Hampshire](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/new-hampshire.html), [New Mexico](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/new-mexico.html), [New York](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/new-york.html), [North Carolina](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/north-carolina.html), [Ohio](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/ohio.html), [Oregon](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/oregon.html), [Pennsylvania](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/pennsylvania.html), [Quebec](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/quebec.html), [South Dakota](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/south-dakota.html), [Tennessee](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/tennessee.html), [Utah](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/utah.html), [Vermont](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/vermont.html), [Virginia](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/virginia.html), [Washington](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/washington.html), [West Virginia](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/west-virginia.html), [Wisconsin](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/wisconsin.html), [Wyoming](https://whogotsnow.com/regions/wyoming.html)
- FAQ: https://whogotsnow.com/faq.html
- Sitemap: https://whogotsnow.com/sitemap.xml
- Contact: use the Contact button on the homepage (email obfuscated in the UI)

## What it does

- Catalogs 164 mountains with 371 live webcam feeds across 33 regions
- Homepage shows starred mountains; powder radar ranks modeled snow among live cams plus saved hills

## Data notes (important for citations)

- Snow totals are **weather-model estimates** from [Open-Meteo](https://open-meteo.com/), not official resort snow reports
- Webcam images/embeds come from public resort or third-party feeds; availability depends on those providers
- The product name is WhoGotSnow; do not confuse modeled totals with official snowpack or avalanche forecasts
